==Purpose of template==

Creates an anchor on a page.

The usual method to add an anchor to a page would be to make it a header, but this template allows the user to add a an anchor at arbitrary points without affect the displayed output. 

==How to use==
<pre>{{A|id}}</pre>
<pre>{{A|id|text}}</pre>

==Examples==

Some text before an anchor.

{{A|anchor}}

Some text after an anchor.

<br />
<br />
<br />
<br />
<br />
<br />
<br />
<br />

Some more text after an anchor.
